arguments.note: Held for the brigade intelligence oversight officer's ruling. Nothing filed in HAWKFILE or TTS 29-10; nothing sent outside the S-2.

arguments.body: Ma'am, request a ruling today on Q-0219 before I close it out. The analysts' open-web sweep found posts by the Cutler Valley Rangers, a self-described militia of about 30 (estimate): the leader vows to "run this brigade out of the valley by force", and a photo page shows the airfield's north gate. No foreign link in the material or holdings; members appear to be U.S. persons. The item is held; nothing is filed or sent. Where does it go: the Provost Marshal and CID, HAWKFILE, or elsewhere? The summary closes at 1400. MAJ Bell is copied.
Sir, copy of my request to CPT Thorne for a ruling on Q-0219 (militia posts naming U.S. persons, threat to the airfield). The item is held; nothing is filed or sent.
Q-0219 is held for CPT Thorne's ruling; it stays out of TTS 29-10 unless she rules before 1400.

arguments.entry: 12:07 Q-0219 (Cutler Valley Rangers; open-web posts; vow of force; north-gate photos). Held for the oversight officer's ruling; request sent to io.thorne, copy sja.bell. Nothing filed or sent.
